title: TechOps-CloudOps-DevOps-Staff
description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 11, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1757946

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Staff CloudOps Engineer with 3–4 years of hands-on experience in AWS and Azure environments. The primary focus of this role is supporting DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automation scripting, and container orchestration. The role also involves contributing to basic cloud infrastructure management and support. You will assist in troubleshooting, support deployment pipelines, and participate in operations across cloud-native environments.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Assist in resolving infrastructure and DevOps-related incidents and service requests.
* Support CI/CD pipeline operations and automation workflows.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform.
* Monitor platform health using native tools like AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor.
* Collaborate with CloudOps and DevOps teams to address deployment or configuration issues.
* Maintain and update runbooks, SOPs, and automation scripts as needed.
* You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
* You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
* In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Working knowledge of AWS and Azure core services.
* Experience with Terraform; exposure to CloudFormation or ARM templates is a plus.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), and Helm.
* Basic scripting in Bash; knowledge of Python is a plus.
* Understanding of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of IAM, security groups, VPC/VNet, and basic networking.
* Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3–4 years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure support.
* Hands-on experience in supporting cloud platforms like AWS and/or Azure.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms.
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure) preferred.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational shift-based support environment.
* No location constraints

  

**Technologies and Tools**

**Must haves**

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (hands-on)
* CI/CD: Basic experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
* Containerization: Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Docker
* Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor
* Scripting: Bash
* Incident Management: Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tool

  

**Good to have**

* Templates: CloudFormation, ARM templates
* Scripting: Python
* Security: IAM Policies, RBAC
* Observability: Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry
* Networking: VPC/VNet basics, load balancers
* Certification: AWS/Azure (Associate-level preferred)

  

**What we look for**

* **Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud technologies and DevOps practices.**
* **Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.**
* **Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.**
* **Detail-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.**

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Job Description

Netstratum is looking for a motivated Junior DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps team and learn how modern software is built, deployed and run at scale. You will work alongside experienced engineers and support our development and operations teams with Linux, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, cloud platforms and monitoring tools. This role is ideal for a recent graduate with a strong foundation in Linux and networking, an interest in cloud and automation, and the eagerness to learn hands-on in a production environment.

Responsibilities

* Assist in implementing technology solutions that enable the business.
* Support the development of software tools and automation for DevOps responsibilities and CI/CD product integration.
* Collaborate with teams in an Agile development cycle.
* Assist in automating infrastructure deployment, configuration, and system administration using Python, Terraform, Ansible, and other automation tools.
* Help build, manage, and support containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes.
* Support the maintenance of CI/CD and GitOps workflows using Jenkins, Argo CD, Git, and GitHub.
* Support cloud infrastructure across Azure and AWS environments, including virtual machines, VPC/VNet, storage, and access management.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, and capacity using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Zabbix.
* Help configure, maintain, and upgrade server and Linux-based infrastructure.
* Assist in identifying security vulnerabilities and applying appropriate updates and fixes.
* Troubleshoot issues across development, staging, and production environments and take part in Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
* Support production operations, including Incident Management and issue resolution, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Create and maintain documentation for systems, processes, and runbooks.
* Continuously learn new tools and technologies and suggest improvements to existing systems.

Desired Skills

* Basic knowledge of cloud platforms, including Azure and AWS, with exposure to virtual machines, VPC/VNet, and storage services
* Basic understanding of containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with CI/CD and version control, including Jenkins, Git, and GitHub
* Awareness of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation using Terraform and Ansible is an added advantage
* Exposure to monitoring tools, including Prometheus, Grafana, and Zabbix is an added advantage
* Good knowledge of Linux operating systems and commonly used commands
* Basic scripting and programming skills using Bash/Shell and Python; knowledge of Java is an added advantage
* Basic understanding of networking concepts, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, Routing, Subnetting, NAT, Firewalls, and Load Balancing
* Exposure to virtualization technologies, including VMware, Hyper-V, and KVM is an added advantage
* Certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900), RHCSA, or CCNA are an added advantage
* Academic projects or internships in DevOps, cloud, or system administration are an added advantage
* Good analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Strong willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to collaborate effectively with development, operations, and other technical teams

title: Platform Engineer (Azure DevOps)
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Location: Kochi (Hybrid)**  
**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **Platform Engineer** to join our **Platform Engineering** organization. In this role, you will help evolve, operate, and secure **our Internal Developer Platform (IDP)** , ensuring it remains scalable, secure, and easy to use for development teams across the company.

This position requires deep technical expertise in **GitHub Enterprise** , **Azure DevOps** , and strong hands‑on experience in DevSecOps and application security, including **GitHub Advanced Security** .

You will work closely with engineering, security, and operations teams to drive automation, standardization, and the adoption of platform best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
  
**Own and manage the Internal Developer Platform (IDP)** , ensuring reliability, scalability, and developer experience excellence.

**Maintain and administer GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps** as primary platform tooling.

**Migrating code repositories and pipelines** from Azure DevOps to GitHub Enterprise.

**Configure, enforce, and continuously improve centralized security and compliance rulesets** , including:

* Branch protection rules
* Quality gates
* Security policies
* Workflow governance

**Implement and maintain workflow automations** to streamline development, CI/CD, and governance activities.

**Manage and review access controls** , ensuring least‑privilege and compliance in GitHub Enterprise and Azure DevOps.

**Integrate and operationalize GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS)** , including:

* Code scanning
* Secret scanning
* Dependency scanning

**Collaborate with security teams** to enforce secure-by-default patterns across the platform.

**Provide technical mentorship** to engineers on DevSecOps best practices and platform capabilities.

**Continuously monitor platform performance, usage, and security posture** , and drive improvements.

**Required Skills and Qualification:**

* 5+ years of experience in DevSecOps and/or Platform Engineering
* Strong hands-on experience with:
  + Azure
    - Cloud Architecture
    - Well-Architected Framework
  + Azure DevOps
    - Azure Boards
    - Azure Repos
    - Azure Pipelines
    - Azure Test Plans
  + GitHub Enterprise
    - GitHub Actions
    - GitHub Advanced Security
    - GitHub Packages
    - GitHub Pages
    - GitHub Issues
* Proficiency in DevSecOps areas
  + Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)
  + Agile Work Management (Scrum/Kanban)
  + Application Security (SAST/DAST/SCA)
  + Platform Engineering principles
    - Golden Paths
    - CI/CD workflow templates
    - Platform-as-a-Product mindset
  + Developer Experience (DevEx)
  + CI/CD Best Practices
  + Cloud Architecture
  + Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, YAML, or similar.
  + Knowledge of DORA metrics and software delivery performance measurement.
  + Experience integrating Azure DevOps and GitHub APIs.
  + Experience with AKS, Container Apps, Kubernetes, and containerized workloads.
  + Microsoft certifications in Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Application Security

**Working for us:**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

title: Salesforce DevOps Engineer
description:
Kochi Recruitment

Dear Candidate

**Candidate is hiring for Salesforce DevOps Engineer**

**Hiring for Kochi Location**  
**Recruitment Drive: 31st October 2026**  
✅ **Notice Period: Immediate Joiners to 90 Days**

If you have experience in **Salesforce DevOps, CI/CD, Git, Copado, Gearset, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or Salesforce Release Management**, this is your opportunity to work on enterprise-scale Salesforce implementations and accelerate your career with Cognizant.

**Job Summary**

DevOps Engineer role in a multinational organization focusing on Salesforce DevOps and Git based automation for cloud native delivery pipelines. The position requires six to ten years of experience in designing scalable continuous integration and deployment workflows improving release reliability and collaborating with cross functional teams in a hybrid day shift model without travel.

**Responsibilities**

* Drive end to end Salesforce DevOps pipelines by designing robust continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows that enhance release frequency while maintaining system stability and compliance across environments
* Implement automated build and deployment processes using Git based version management to ensure traceable changes efficient branching strategies and reliable rollback mechanisms for complex Salesforce configurations
* Develop reusable automation scripts and integration jobs that streamline metadata migration test execution and environment synchronization so teams can focus on high value configuration and solution design
* Monitor pipeline health and platform performance through metrics and dashboards proactively resolving deployment bottlenecks and minimizing downtime to safeguard user experience and business continuity
* Collaborate closely with Salesforce administrators developers and quality engineering partners to align deployment plans with sprint goals reduce manual deployment steps and support predictable release cycles
* Establish standardized DevOps practices including peer review processes and controlled promotion workflows that help reduce configuration drift and strengthen governance across production and nonproduction environments
* Optimize hybrid work collaboration by leveraging secure remote access and shared tooling so cross site team members can coordinate deployments manage incidents and document operational runbooks in a consistent manner
* Apply secure coding and configuration management practices within the Salesforce ecosystem to protect data integrity in finance and accounting related solutions while adhering to organizational risk guidelines
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing release metrics identifying recurring issues and proposing automation enhancements that improve operational efficiency and reduce deployment lead times
* Support day shift operations by providing timely resolution of deployment failures configuration conflicts and integration issues ensuring that core business functions can depend on stable and predictable system behavior
* Coordinate with infrastructure and security teams to ensure that DevOps tooling access controls and environment configurations meet enterprise standards and enable safe collaboration across global business units
* Document pipeline designs deployment procedures and troubleshooting steps in clear operational guides so new team members can adopt best practices quickly and maintain consistent execution quality
* Engage with stakeholders from finance and accounting domains when relevant to understand release impact on reporting and transaction processes and translate these needs into reliable deployment strategies

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate substantial experience between six and ten years in DevOps engineering with a primary focus on Salesforce environments and automation of application lifecycle processes
* Show advanced proficiency in Git based workflows including branching models merge strategies and version tagging that support scalable team collaboration and precise deployment control
* Exhibit strong capability in configuring and operating Salesforce DevOps tooling or release management platforms to orchestrate metadata deployments automated testing and environment comparisons
* Apply sound understanding of continuous integration and continuous delivery concepts to design pipelines that integrate unit testing static analysis and validation checks before production promotion
* Display familiarity with finance and accounting processes as a valuable advantage when supporting releases that affect billing revenue recognition or financial reporting modules
* Utilize solid skills in scripting or configuration driven automation to integrate DevOps pipelines with monitoring notification or ticketing systems that support efficient incident response
* Maintain effective communication and documentation habits suited to a hybrid work model enabling seamless collaboration with onsite and remote team members during day shift operations
* Commit to secure and compliant handling of configuration changes and data access within Salesforce landscapes aligning DevOps practices with organizational policies and regulatory expectations
